units.rationale: Root is set to the call result createApi(). Decided by reading createApi: it returns {slugify, truncate, titleCase} plus one `${style}Case` key per Object.keys(SEPARATORS) = ['kebab','snake'], i.e. kebabCase and snakeCase. SEPARATORS is a module-local literal never mutated, so the export set is exactly {slugify, truncate, titleCase, kebabCase, snakeCase}, which matches the names src/index.js re-exports. The internal helpers words/SEPARATORS/createApi are carried as B-WORDS and B-CASE-CONVERTERS.
Static top-level assignment of the string literal '2.1.0'; carried as the named ESM export VERSION.
